$comment: Validate fixture cases (W1 R7 P7 t12). Each case is the project in base/ with the files under cases/<id>/ laid over it (a file there replaces or adds a file) and the paths in `remove` taken away. A `.keep` file only keeps an empty case folder in git and is never copied. Every case is invented; it names no real person, organization, or client. The legacy validator's recorded result for each case is in test/golden/validate/.
